description: Redesign the Student Dashboard (DashboardPage.tsx) and dashboard.css to feel premium and modern. Modern welcome card with gradient, refined GPA and progress cards, premium agenda items, and polished metric displays. Also ensure the Teacher Dashboard (TeacherDashboardPage.tsx) and Admin Dashboard (AdminPages.tsx) get similar treatment via shared dashboard CSS classes.
steps: Read frontend/src/pages/student/DashboardPage.tsx fully to understand the welcome card, GPA card, progress card, and agenda section.
Read frontend/src/styles/dashboard.css fully to understand current dashboard styles.
Read frontend/src/pages/teacher/TeacherDashboardPage.tsx (first 100 lines) to understand teacher dashboard structure.

Redesign the welcome-card: Modern gradient background (primary navy to primary-container blue) with floating decorative pseudo-elements, refined typography (larger greeting, subtle subtitle), animated entrance.
Redesign the GPA card: Glassmorphism background, larger gradient GPA value with better font weight, animated orb icon, modern badge styling, subtle golden halo effect.
Redesign the Progress card: Modern doughnut chart container, refined center label, better spacing for progress text, premium note styling.
Redesign the Agenda section: Modern agenda items with left accent border (color-coded), hover elevation, refined time display, icon backgrounds with tonal colors.

Add new dashboard CSS in dashboard.css: Premium stat-card grid for quick metrics, modern card hover states, gradient text for key values, refined spacing using 8px grid, smooth transitions for card interactions.
Update the shared welcome-card style in components.css or dashboard.css to work for all dashboard roles (student, teacher, admin, quality) with the same premium gradient treatment.
Add premium micro-interactions: card hover elevation, stat value fade-in, agenda item press feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Welcome card has premium gradient background (navy to blue) with decorative floating elements
GPA card has glassmorphism effect, gradient value text, animated golden orb
Progress card has modern styling with refined doughnut container
Agenda items have color-coded accent borders and hover elevation
All dashboard cards have smooth hover transitions
Teacher and Admin dashboards benefit from the shared dashboard CSS improvements
RTL layout preserved in all dashboard components
verification: Read DashboardPage.tsx and verify component structure and imports unchanged
Read dashboard.css and verify syntactic correctness
Verify class names in DashboardPage.tsx match CSS selectors in dashboard.css
